title: SunSet Boat tours
specs: Cruise through Miami's intercostal waters viewing luxurious waterfront mansions, hotels, restaurants, and islands
Pause at crystal clear 2-3 ft deep sandbar and island beaches
Children are welcome with life jackets available for all ages; children must be supervised

blurb: Guests embark on scenic cruises through Miami's intercostal waters, viewing waterfront mansions, hotels, restaurants, and islands. Tours include a pause at a shallow sandbar and island beaches to enjoy the water and sunset ambiance. Complimentary open bar, ice water, sodas, Bluetooth surround sound, and LED ambient lighting are provided on board.
